# Curtis AI

> Curtis AI is an applied AI company (est. 2026); its first product is Curtis AI, a polyglot AI chat plugin for Obsidian.

## About Curtis AI

- Applied AI company, established 2026.
- Ships products and runs a research arm; the lab is in setup.
- First research subject: the memory system shipping inside Curtis AI.

## Curtis AI Chat (Product 01)

- Polyglot AI chat for Obsidian: 53 built-in providers, one sidebar.
- Local-first: Ollama and LM Studio supported for fully offline use; nothing leaves the machine unless a provider points at the cloud.
- Bring-your-own keys; API keys stored in the OS keychain (Obsidian 1.13+).
- Agent mode: AI calls eleven built-in tools (read/search/create/edit vault notes, semantic search when vault retrieval is on, and more), plus any tool exposed by user-connected MCP servers (Streamable HTTP, opt-in) and read-only Cloud Storage on a user-connected GCP project (service-account key, opt-in).
- Named agents: reusable worker configs — persona + model routing + tool ceilings — bound to any chat or spawned as swarm specialists; swarm mode lets a leader chat spawn follower agents that work subtasks in their own panes.
- Other features: multi-model arena (2-4 models streaming one prompt in parallel), multi-pane chat (tabs and popout windows), terminal pane with an opt-in run_command agent tool, scheduled runs (a prompt or agent on a daily/interval cadence, headless, results as notes), MCP server mode (serve the vault and agents to external AI apps on localhost), a public plugin API for other Obsidian plugins, inline autocomplete (off by default), inline diff rewrite, @-mention notes as context, voice I/O (Whisper dictation in; read-aloud with a sentence player, voice picker, and karaoke highlight), cross-conversation search, vault retrieval (semantic context auto-injected), desktop notifications, chat import from ChatGPT/Claude plus the portable .curt format, /export to Markdown, editable long-term memory.

## Install

- Obsidian community plugin listing: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/curtis-ai-chat
- Deep link: obsidian://show-plugin?id=curtis-ai-chat
- Manual: download main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from the latest GitHub release into .obsidian/plugins/curtis-ai-chat/, then enable under Settings -> Community plugins.

## Facts

- Current version: 2.0.0
- Minimum Obsidian version: 1.13.0
- License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Jordan Newell)
- No telemetry or analytics. Source contains no sendBeacon/XHR/WebSocket/analytics calls; network requests go only to the user-configured AI provider endpoint, OpenAI's transcription endpoint when voice dictation is used, OpenAI's OAuth endpoints (auth.openai.com) when the "Sign in with ChatGPT" provider is used (desktop, user-initiated, official OpenAI program; tokens stored in the OS keychain), site favicons for external links in chat (icons.duckduckgo.com, one request per domain; "Link favicons" toggle under Settings -> Chat UI, on by default; off keeps chat rendering fully local), opt-in (off-by-default) web_search/read_url agent tools (DuckDuckGo, Jina Reader), opt-in (off-by-default) user-configured MCP server URLs, and Google's OAuth/Cloud Storage endpoints when the opt-in (off-by-default) GCP connector is enabled. The opt-in (off-by-default) plugin MCP server mode additionally serves the vault on localhost (127.0.0.1, bearer-token protected) when enabled; that is inbound local connections, not egress.
